topic: How would the 0.25 dB passband loss affect link budget margins in low-noise satellite receiver frontends?
consensus_response: A 0.25 dB passband loss compromises link budget margins in low-noise satellite receiver frontends due to increased noise power and reduced signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). This reduction in SNR leads to a decrease in link margin, necessitating an increase in transmitter power or a corresponding decrease in receiver sensitivity. The impact on link margin is more pronounced in systems with limited margin for error or operating at capacity limits.
